title: nan
authors: Trujillo J.-C.; Munguia R.; Guerra E.; Grau A.
key_contribution: Presents a cooperative monocular visual SLAM framework for multi-UAV formations aided by visual inter-UAV range measurements, validated with nonlinear observability analysis and simulations.
